windowsInstallFailure.action: Retain failing output, recheck once after the concurrent DAT installation completed; no elevation, permissions edit or forced process termination.
windowsInstallFailure.confirmedCause: Earlier TOOLCHAIN_EMPTY_DATA report states that all three token sources shared one dependency directory. Parallel npm ci and the EMA retry therefore touched the same installation. A later graph check found DAT empty; CAWELON still had a junction to DAT. EMA had become independent.
windowsInstallFailure.repair: Removed only the explicitly verified CAWELON junction, created a separate directory, and rebuild independent installations. No recursive delete, elevation, ACL change or process termination used.

datFirstVerificationReason: Its successful tests occurred before the shared-directory interference was detected; a new final verification is required after independent installation.
